description: This Java class models the product pricing details within an e-commerce system. It includes fields for price amount, special dates, price type, descriptions, availability, and metadata annotations for persistence with JPA/Hibernate.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: Entity representing pricing details for a product including amount, special price periods, description, and associated availability information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product price.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product price.

methods.name: getProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: setProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Sets the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date for a special promotional price.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for a special promotional price.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date for a special promotional price.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for a special promotional price.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the special promotional price amount.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Sets the special promotional price amount.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with the product price.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the collection of price descriptions.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Indicates whether this is the default price for the product.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Marks this price as the default or not.

methods.name: setProductAvailability
methods.description: Associates the product availability details.

methods.name: getProductAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves the associated product availability.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the product price.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier of the product price.

methods.name: setProductPriceType
methods.description: Sets the type of the product price (e.g., one-time, recurring).

methods.name: getProductPriceType
methods.description: Gets the type of the product price.
